key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as markets priced in further RBA rate hikes, with traders bracing for tighter monetary policy
Iron ore sector facing a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur cleared WA bulk test hurdle
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget; banks forecast record house price declines
EV sales surpassed petrol cars in Australia for first time, signalling consumer shift amid soaring fuel costs
ASIC launched review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar) showed relative strength
Bathla construction collapse flagged as symptom of broader housing/credit fragility
Nvidia reaffirmed AI boom continuation; Australia faces acute shortage of AI and skilled tradies

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical distraction; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) outperforming on capital raises and grade announcements. Macarthur cleared WA bulk test.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from iron ore price reset. Small-cap gold and critical-mines names offer relative value. Monitor iron ore contract pricing closely.

sectors.trend: CBA home loan applications down 15% post-budget; banks forecasting record house price falls. ASIC whistleblower review at accounting giants adds governance overhang. Fee-pricing loophole at CBA/Westpac under scrutiny.
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk for CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX. Credit cycle turning. Defensive positioning warranted; watch NPL trends and provisioning guidance.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surging on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns; energy transition costs mounting. Argentina's Falklands oil sanctions add geopolitical risk to LNG supply chains.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, BHP.AX (LNG) benefit from gas price strength. Transition-cost headlines pressure renewable names. Monitor AEMO pricing.

sectors.trend: EV sales overtook petrol cars; VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally. Housing construction to follow prices lower. Bathla collapse signals construction-sector fragility. Banks forecast record house price declines.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX, ICPL.AX) face rental pressure if housing cycle weakens. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) benefit from fuel-cost-driven EV shift. Construction names (WBC.AX exposure, builders) at risk.

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging. Nvidia confirms AI boom intact. Australia faces AI-worker and tradie shortage.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma retail) monitor GLP-1 disruption. Tech exposure via ASX-listed data centre and AI infrastructure plays. Skilled-labour shortage supports construction and services demand.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce rate-sensitive REIT and construction exposure; monitor RBA statement language

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit contraction and price decline
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce bank equity exposure; favour dividend-paying staples; watch NPL and provisioning data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price reset / demand shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure-play iron ore; favour gold (Aurum, WES.AX gold exposure) and critical minerals
Maintain commodity hedges; monitor AUD/USD; hold gold as safe haven
Monitor for regulatory action; avoid over-concentration in audit-dependent small caps
Prefer integrated energy majors over pure-play renewables; watch AEMO and policy signals

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines small caps
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk premium, iron ore shakeout, and grade upgrades at Aurum, Kaoko, Vanadium Resources support relative outperformance

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas-exposed energy majors on TMK rate surge
opportunities.rationale: Mongolian drilling push and Beetaloo cartel dynamics support gas pricing; Woodside and Santos benefit

opportunities.recommendation: Position in consumer staples for EV/fuel-cost shift
opportunities.rationale: EV sales overtaking petrol cars structurally benefits WES, WOW; defensive in rate-hike environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce bank equity and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 15% loan-application drop, record house-price-fall forecasts, and RBA hike risk compress NIMs and asset values
Structural shakeout in iron ore demand; war headlines masking the underlying supply/demand reset
RBA may hike further; stalling economy creates volatility; cash yields attractive

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as RBA rate-hike expectations and housing credit contraction dominate. Iron ore weakness and bank NIM compression weigh on ^AXJO. Small-cap miners and gold provide relative strength. Expect 2–4% index volatility into RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Bull case returns per macrobusiness, but contingent on RBA pausing and housing stabilising. Structural themes – EV transition, AI infrastructure, critical minerals – support selective outperformance. Housing construction downturn may persist 12–18 months. Australia's per-capita growth lagging Canada is a concern.

VW / global auto sector job cuts spillover
